heading.title: First Division · Part VI · Suits Relating to Movable Property

article.title: Three years.
article.content:
Article68Three years.

The Schedule  ·  First Division—Suits · Part VI—Suits Relating to Movable Property
For specific movable property lost, or acquired by theft, or dishonest misappropriation or conversion.
Period of limitationThree years.

Time from which period begins to runWhen the person having the right to the possession of the property first learns in whose possession it is.
